dialogues.speaker: Game Master
dialogues.text: Your search for the legendary treasure has led you to a nervous merchant. She seems guarded. Questioning her could be tough...

dialogues.speaker: Game Master
dialogues.text: ...You convince her to show you the way. But suddenly, a vicious Sternshield Crab appears to block your path.

dialogues.speaker: Game Master
dialogues.text: ...Following a tip from the Armored Crab, you at long last find the treasure, but standing guard above it is a cold and unforgiving Cryo Regisvine...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait! Surely you can't use Persuasion on plants!?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yeah, I can! I got "Speak with Plants" now. And look at that — a natural 20!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: ...Fine. The Cryo Regisvine sheepishly burrows back into the ground. The treasure is all yours.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Get together with your friends. Adventure awaits!
